# SafeMotion AI — Deterministic Physical AI Safety Shield
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org | AEO Specification

> SafeMotion AI is a sub-millisecond, deterministic Control Barrier Function (CBF-QP) safety gateway and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for embodied AI, mobile robotics, and autonomous vehicles.

## Overview
- Author: Engineer Abdullah Bin Zafar
- Repository: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/safemotion-ai
- Tests: 18/18 passing (100%)
- Core Performance: <35 microseconds analytical CBF-QP solution
- Mathematical Guarantee: Forward invariance h(x) >= 0 (Nagumo's Theorem)
- Integration: FastAPI v1 REST API, MCP Stdio and SSE transport

## Architecture
- Evaluates closed-form minimum-norm safety projections intercepting unsafe AI/LLM velocity commands.
- Standardizes global billing via Automated MoR (Merchant of Record).
